$comment: Capture group (camera.*, widget.*, daily.*, collage.*, notifications.push) — redesign Pass 2 on Retro, 2026-10-16. Surface tokens exist only where Retro measured something specific to the surface (Postcard modal ST-03, recap preview ST-04, Rewind control row RWA/RWB, Glance widget APK/preview art) or where the mechanics reference defines the control (Locket shutter, BeReal dual image, worker composition). Everything else is a global token or a component (design/components.md) named in design/surfaces/*.md. Decisions: design/MERGE_DECISIONS.md 'Redesign — Capture (RC-*)'. camera.overnight added by the new-features consolidation (2026-10-16; MERGE_DECISIONS 'New features (ON-*)').

Replaces Yope's full-width 1 : 1.38 viewfinder (MERGE_DECISIONS RC-2). A full-bleed preview (C-35) was rejected: a 3:4 photo filling a 393 × 852 screen shows only 61 % of the captured width (RC-2).

value.ios: UIVideoEditorController (the system trimmer, its own chrome and controls), videoMaximumDuration = camera.capture.duration.videoMax, videoQuality typeHigh
value.android: media surface (color.global.backgroundDeep, dark appearance): C-29 SheetHeader (camera.trim.cancel · camera.trim.title · camera.trim.done); the video aspect-fit in the remaining space, looping the chosen range, tap = play / pause; size.global.screenMargin below it a Material 3 RangeSlider (default colours) inside size.global.screenMargin, the range at most camera.capture.duration.videoMax and at least one second, starting on the first camera.capture.duration.videoMax of the video; size.global.sectionHeaderToContent below the slider the range line camera.trim.range in text role listSubtitle, color.global.textSecondary; Done → Media3 Transformer clip (H.264 / AAC MP4) with the C-28 loading indicator on the video
value.trigger: a library pick (camera.capture library circle) whose length in whole seconds exceeds camera.capture.duration.videoMax
value.cannotTrim: native alert camera.capture.videoTooLong.title / .message / .dismiss; back to the camera

camera.trim.layout.screen.element: trimming a library video to the length a post may hold
camera.trim.layout.screen.evidence: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/uikit/uivideoeditorcontroller ("an editing interface for trimming video", videoMaximumDuration); references/auto/retro/apk/retro-android-2026.10.1150-strings.txt video_editor_* ("Trim Video", "Done", "Video trim timeline", "%1$s – %2$s (%3$s)", one-second start / end steps) and journal_composer_error_video_too_long_*; Material 3 RangeSlider (https://m3.material.io/components/sliders/overview, "Range sliders")
camera.trim.layout.screen.method: platform component on iOS; on Android (no system trimmer) the platform range slider with Retro's editor wording, composed from existing components (C-29 header, C-28 loading)
camera.trim.layout.screen.notes: The server enforces the same limit (app_config.video_max_ms, create_post video_too_long; the worker cuts the stored video), so a client that skips this step still never posts a longer video. Retro's own trimmer layout was not captured: Android draws Material 3's range slider instead of Retro's thumbnail strip (Gap).

camera.capture.size.recordingOutline.element: progress stroke traced around the viewfinder (radius.global.viewfinder) while a video records, colour color.global.surfaceLight
camera.capture.size.recordingOutline.evidence: https://help.locket.com/en/articles/7915017 (read 2026-10-16): ‘The yellow outline around the viewfinder indicates that capture is in progress.’ (the mechanic); stroke: the platform progress indicator’s default thickness — androidx compose material3 tokens/CircularProgressIndicatorTokens.kt (VERSION v0_7_0) ActiveThickness = TrackThickness = 4.0.dp, ProgressIndicator.kt ProgressIndicatorDefaults.CircularStrokeWidth = TrackThickness (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/androidx/androidx/androidx-main/compose/material3/material3/src/commonMain/kotlin/androidx/compose/material3/, read 2026-10-16)
camera.capture.size.recordingOutline.notes: Replaces 6 pt (gap fill G2-9), re-sourced under owner decision 22 (2026-10-16). No public frame of Locket while a video records was found (App Store and Play screenshots, help center, the @locketcamera TikTok listing; YouTube tutorials sit behind a sign-in check) — the smallest capture that closes it: one screenshot of Locket recording a video. Colour color.global.surfaceLight (RC-3).
camera.capture.size.recordingOutline.method: a determinate progress stroke traced around the viewfinder (radius.global.viewfinder), filling linearly over camera.capture.duration.videoMax; thickness = Material 3’s progress-indicator default, used on both platforms (HIG gives no progress stroke)
